minutes.headline: ZBA continued the Dunkin'-style drive-thru hearing to Feb 25 after the building inspector rescinded his approval
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals took up a request to continue the hearing on a proposed carry-out restaurant with drive-thru at 1 Main Street/947 Massachusetts Avenue after the building commissioner rescinded his prior determination that the use could be allowed by special permit. After extended public comment from residents arguing the bylaws prohibit drive-thrus in the Village Center District and warning of a possible land court appeal, the board voted to continue the hearing to February 25, 2026 at 7 p.m.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the hearing on a proposed drive-thru restaurant at 1 Main Street/947 Massachusetts Avenue to February 25.
The continuance followed the building commissioner rescinding his earlier determination that the drive-thru could be allowed by special permit.
Residents argued the zoning bylaw prohibits drive-thru restaurants in the Village Center District, citing specific bylaw sections.
A resident warned that approving the project over the bylaw and the rescinded determination could prompt residents to file a land court appeal.
Before voting, the board debated whether it needed to formally open the meeting to accept public comment on the continuance.

why_it_matters: The outcome decides whether a carry-out restaurant with a drive-thru can be built in the Village Center District, a use residents say the bylaw does not permit.
If the board later approves the project over the building commissioner's rescinded determination, residents have said they would pursue a land court appeal, which could mean legal costs for the town.
